purpose: Describe acting exactly as a model, instruction, or expectation specifies.
keywords: Verb dictionary / past form + とおりに; noun + のとおりに / noun + どおりに
I drew the line as the teacher instructed.
Please fold it just like the sample.
formation: Verb dictionary / past form + とおりに; noun + のとおりに / noun + どおりに
restrictions: The model provides the pattern that the action follows.
mistake: Use のとおり after a noun, or an established どおり compound such as 予定どおり.
